OUTSTANDING NEW AUSSIE OWNED SPORTS BAR
May 2026 • Friends
Fantastic new Aussie owned sports bar in the centre of Saigon. Owned by Ryan - this bar is absolutely stunning. Downstairs has lots of of easy seating with TVs running various sports. Upstairs is great with a large - level pool table. The food menu has a vast array of dishes to choose from - Sunday Roast was amazing. Highly recommended you get here to get your food and footy - oh and SUPER COLD beer hit.
